project.name: KitchenMind
project.description: SaaS multiempresa y multisucursal con acceso público nativo, Platform, comercial, aprovisionamiento, dashboard, Calidad y Personal/Asistencia

runtime.database: Turso/libSQL in production; Cloudflare D1 REST remains supported
runtime.objectStorage: adapter pending for binary Quality evidence

database.upgradePolicy: infer already-applied E.2 migrations from sentinels, then apply only missing migrations

securityInvariants: passwords stored only as scrypt hashes with per-user salt
native session tokens stored only as SHA-256 hashes and delivered through HttpOnly cookies
server-validated identity, membership and active organization
Platform MFA and granular platform permissions
tenant and branch scope intersection before operational access
authenticated navigations and private APIs are network-only in the service worker
logout purges KitchenMind CacheStorage and IndexedDB state
biometric data is an external opaque reference; raw fingerprints are forbidden
device secrets are returned once and stored only as hashes
no secrets committed to source control
knownLimitations: binary Quality evidence upload/download requires a private object-storage adapter on Vercel
physical fingerprint-reader validation requires the selected vendor SDK/local bridge

validation.fullNpmCiTypecheckBuild: pass locally and in Vercel production deployment
